obligations.closure_rationale: The actual retained niche has absence plus nonzero values; full tagged EopScalar represents present zero. Checked result access validates its discriminant before selecting value or offset and preserves the inactive output. The independent reduced model executes771 cases including UINT32_MAX; no native padding or inactive-member comparison establishes equality. Transactional scalar/result access and owning construction, deep clone, move and drop have explicit invariants. Actual T66 typed allocation backs each owner, arbitrary resource ID0 is valid, clone copies to distinct storage, and failed admission/allocation preserves live owners. Drop empties before its observer and releases once. C copying remains a caller ownership obligation. Six compiler profiles execute4 anchors,10 compiled controls and4 compiling learner-stub rejections. Independent model histories5192/profile cover exact allocation slots, failure schedules, moves, self/occupied refusals and final releases. Actual native64 and Arm32 object layouts supply two data-model observations; the Arm representation object is neither linked nor executed, and missing Arm setjmp.h is explicit. The late changed-condition owner stage actually imports PR-T66-09 memory.adversarial_allocator after T66, avoiding a reverse early prerequisite. Strict GCC/Clang diagnostics reject void members, void payload use and returning Noreturn bodies without executing them. A protocol unit enum is validated separately. Actual Rust1.93.1 moved-value rejection and single Drop demonstrate a narrower language comparison than C enforcement or ABI equivalence. All13cost dimensions, real allocation/release counts, seven scalar/owner timing samples and build/object/stack observations are retained; unlike contracts are not reported as overhead. Bounded author support only.
